desk:
**BLUF:**  
The OSINT/defence community is focused on fresh diplomatic signals around ending the Ukraine war and US-Russia talks on European security. The single most important thread is Zelenskyy’s report that Russia rejected a ceasefire proposal in Abu Dhabi while the US pushes Moscow for a new security framework with Europe.

## MAIN THREADS

### Ukraine ceasefire talks
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2120600643664568607) and [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2120599815486833081) both report Zelenskyy stating Russian negotiators rejected Ukraine’s ceasefire offer in Abu Dhabi; Moscow is instead floating bilateral non-aggression pacts with individual NATO states.
- [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2120587133299695774) quotes the German government spokesperson confirming key principles for a future agreement were reached in Abu Dhabi by the US, Ukraine and European countries (without Russia) and conveyed to Putin.

### US-Russia security proposal
- [@BarakRavid](https://x.com/BarakRavid/status/2120598925031907690) scoops that the US has asked Russia to submit a new proposal for a future security agreement with Europe that includes steps to ease tensions.

### SBU strike on Russian navy
- [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2120588333600690472) reports the SBU struck the Buyan-M class missile ship *Naro-Fominsk* carrying Kalibr and Oniks missiles.

### CENTCOM Iran blockade update
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2120585719802687832) relays CENTCOM’s update on the naval blockade of southern Iran, noting nearly 4,000 ships transited the Strait of Hormuz and 5 non-compliant vessels disabled.

### Houthi strike on Saudi Arabia
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2120598925031907690) reports Houthis claimed a strike on Saudi pumping station 11 in Yanbu amid ongoing reciprocal strikes.

### Oryol strike assessment
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2120585719802687832) shares OSINT Varta satellite analysis of the 7 Nov Neptune strike on Proton-Electrotex in Oryol, assessing likely hits on defence-linked facilities.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- SBU strike on *Naro-Fominsk* (unconfirmed) — [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2120588333600690472)
- German spokesperson details on Abu Dhabi principles (unconfirmed) — [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2120587133299695774)
- Houthis targeted Yanbu pumping station (unconfirmed) — [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2120598925031907690)
- CENTCOM figures on 1.7 billion barrels and $30 bn blocked (unconfirmed) — [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2120585719802687832)
- Proton-Electrotex facilities likely hit in Oryol (unconfirmed) — [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2120585719802687832)

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts are watching whether the US-Russia security proposal gains traction and if any Abu Dhabi principles produce concrete next steps before year-end. Continued monitoring of Houthi-Saudi exchanges and CENTCOM’s blockade enforcement is expected.
